title: Nonlinear Schrödinger equations with critical Hardy potential and Choquard nonlinearity
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation characterized by contrasting effects between the concentration at the origin of a critical Hardy potential and the intrinsic nonlocality of a Choquard nonlinearity. We prove the existence of a ground state solution through optimizers of an interpolation Hardy-Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequality and derive a non-existence result via Poho\v zaev identities.
